files.README.md:
Northwind Regional Air - release packaging.

release/ holds the artifacts published with each crew-scheduling release;
release/manifest/ carries the manifest extracts themselves and
release/archive/ keeps superseded copies. The duplication check for a
release treats two files as the same artifact only when their stored
bytes match exactly; files that only share a name in two folders are
distinct artifacts.
